8th Grade · Unit 1 · Friendship

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece cannot choose a school club. She asks her sister what she should do. She wants some ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) advice

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece cannot choose a school club. She asks her sister what she should do.” Bu tarif “advice” kelimesine uyar; advice = tavsiye, öğüt. Diğer şıklar: promise (söz), party (parti), friendship (arkadaşlık, dostluk).

2

Selin and her cousin feel deeply connected. Their shared experiences make the connection stronger every year. There is a strong ______ between them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) bond

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin and her cousin feel deeply connected. Their shared experiences make the connection stronger every year.” Bu tarif “bond” kelimesine uyar; bond = bağ. Diğer şıklar: respect (saygı), patience (sabır), invitation (davet, davetiye).

3

Duru wants her friendship with Ece to last forever. She hopes they stay close at every age. She sees Ece as a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) friend for life

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru wants her friendship with Ece to last forever. She hopes they stay close at every age.” Bu tarif “friend for life” kelimesine uyar; friend for life = ömürlük arkadaş. Diğer şıklar: personality (kişilik), concert (konser), snack (atıştırmalık).

4

Elif stays by her friend's side during difficult times. She does not leave her friend when things go wrong. Her behaviour shows ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) loyalty

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif stays by her friend's side during difficult times. She does not leave her friend when things go wrong.” Bu tarif “loyalty” kelimesine uyar; loyalty = sadakat, vefa. Diğer şıklar: guest (misafir, konuk), excuse (mazeret, bahane), mate (arkadaş, dost).

5

Nehir teaches a younger child a new game. She explains each step many times without becoming annoyed. She shows ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) patience

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir teaches a younger child a new game. She explains each step many times without becoming annoyed.” Bu tarif “patience” kelimesine uyar; patience = sabır. Diğer şıklar: best friend (en yakın arkadaş), secret (sır), buddy (kanka, yakın arkadaş).

6

Sena values her friends' different opinions. She listens carefully and treats them with consideration. She shows them ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) respect

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena values her friends' different opinions. She listens carefully and treats them with consideration.” Bu tarif “respect” kelimesine uyar; respect = saygı. Diğer şıklar: excuse (mazeret, bahane), bond (bağ), friend for life (ömürlük arkadaş).

7

İpek reads an adventure story. The characters find a chest full of valuable gold and jewels. They discover a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) treasure

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek reads an adventure story. The characters find a chest full of valuable gold and jewels.” Bu tarif “treasure” kelimesine uyar; treasure = hazine. Diğer şıklar: guest (misafir, konuk), advice (tavsiye, öğüt), personality (kişilik).

8

Eylül receives a card with a party date, time and address. Her cousin asks her to attend the celebration. The card is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) invitation

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül receives a card with a party date, time and address. Her cousin asks her to attend the celebration.” Bu tarif “invitation” kelimesine uyar; invitation = davet, davetiye. Diğer şıklar: buddy (kanka, yakın arkadaş), mate (arkadaş, dost), secret (sır).

9

Cemre has homework, a music lesson and a family task this afternoon. She has no spare time for another activity. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) busy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre has homework, a music lesson and a family task this afternoon. She has no spare time for another activity.” Bu tarif “busy” kelimesine uyar; busy = meşgul. Diğer şıklar: mutual (karşılıklı), priceless (paha biçilmez), serious (ciddi).

10

Melis admits that she makes a mistake during a game. She tells the truth even when it is difficult. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) honest

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis admits that she makes a mistake during a game. She tells the truth even when it is difficult.” Bu tarif “honest” kelimesine uyar; honest = dürüst. Diğer şıklar: alone (yalnız), thrilling (heyecan verici), stuffed (tıka basa doymuş).

11

Sıla remains a faithful friend through good and bad times. She never abandons her friendship for personal advantage. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) loyal

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla remains a faithful friend through good and bad times. She never abandons her friendship for personal advantage.” Bu tarif “loyal” kelimesine uyar; loyal = sadık, vefalı. Diğer şıklar: full (tok), unconditional (koşulsuz), laid-back (sakin, rahat tavırlı).

12

Defne enjoys meeting people at school events. She confidently starts conversations with new classmates. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) outgoing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne enjoys meeting people at school events. She confidently starts conversations with new classmates.” Bu tarif “outgoing” kelimesine uyar; outgoing = dışa dönük, girişken. Diğer şıklar: supportive (destekleyici), serious (ciddi), mutual (karşılıklı).

13

Buse always does the tasks she agrees to do. People know they can depend on her to keep her word. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) reliable

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse always does the tasks she agrees to do. People know they can depend on her to keep her word.” Bu tarif “reliable” kelimesine uyar; reliable = güvenilir. Diğer şıklar: unconditional (koşulsuz), laid-back (sakin, rahat tavırlı), full (tok).

14

İdil eats a very large dinner and several desserts. She feels completely filled with food and cannot eat another bite. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) stuffed

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil eats a very large dinner and several desserts. She feels completely filled with food and cannot eat another bite.” Bu tarif “stuffed” kelimesine uyar; stuffed = tıka basa doymuş. Diğer şıklar: busy (meşgul), honest (dürüst), alone (yalnız).

15

Zeynep reads a fast-moving adventure story. Each new danger creates strong excitement and keeps her eager to read. The story is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) thrilling

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep reads a fast-moving adventure story. Each new danger creates strong excitement and keeps her eager to read.” Bu tarif “thrilling” kelimesine uyar; thrilling = heyecan verici. Diğer şıklar: outgoing (dışa dönük, girişken), supportive (destekleyici), priceless (paha biçilmez).

16

Mina accidentally damages her friend's notebook. She feels sorry and wants to say that she regrets it. She decides to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) apologise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina accidentally damages her friend's notebook. She feels sorry and wants to say that she regrets it.” Bu tarif “apologise” kelimesine uyar; apologise = özür dilemek. Diğer şıklar: come over (birinin evine uğramak), go for a walk (yürüyüşe çıkmak), spend time (vakit geçirmek).

17

Pelin gives her word that she can help at the event. She does not do what she says, although nothing prevents her. She chooses to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) break a promise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin gives her word that she can help at the event. She does not do what she says, although nothing prevents her.” Bu tarif “break a promise” kelimesine uyar; break a promise = sözünü tutmamak. Diğer şıklar: back up (arka çıkmak, desteklemek), text (mesaj atmak), survive (ayakta kalmak, devam etmek).

18

Derya enjoys her classmates' company. They understand one another and rarely argue. She says, "I ______ my classmates."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) get on well with

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya enjoys her classmates' company. They understand one another and rarely argue.” Bu tarif “get on well with” kelimesine uyar; get on well with = biriyle iyi geçinmek. Diğer şıklar: support (desteklemek), join (katılmak), count on (güvenmek, bel bağlamak).

19

Sena believes that her friend tells the truth. She feels safe sharing private information with him. She can ______ him.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) trust

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena believes that her friend tells the truth. She feels safe sharing private information with him.” Bu tarif “trust” kelimesine uyar; trust = güvenmek. Diğer şıklar: apologise (özür dilemek), come over (birinin evine uğramak), go for a walk (yürüyüşe çıkmak).

20

Eda plans a picnic with her cousins. She wants to ask two classmates to attend as well. She decides to ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) invite

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda plans a picnic with her cousins. She wants to ask two classmates to attend as well.” Bu tarif “invite” kelimesine uyar; invite = davet etmek. Diğer şıklar: spend time (vakit geçirmek), text (mesaj atmak), break a promise (sözünü tutmamak).

21

Cem has some art materials. He lets his friend use them too, so both can finish their pictures. He agrees to ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) share

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem has some art materials. He lets his friend use them too, so both can finish their pictures.” Bu tarif “share” kelimesine uyar; share = paylaşmak. Diğer şıklar: join (katılmak), count on (güvenmek, bel bağlamak), get on well with (biriyle iyi geçinmek).

22

Eren reads about a person lost on an island. The person finds food, water and shelter to stay alive. These things help the person ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) survive

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren reads about a person lost on an island. The person finds food, water and shelter to stay alive.” Bu tarif “survive” kelimesine uyar; survive = ayakta kalmak, devam etmek. Diğer şıklar: trust (güvenmek), support (desteklemek), invite (davet etmek).

23

Baran buys a ticket to hear a band live. Musicians perform songs on a stage in front of an audience. The event is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) concert

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran buys a ticket to hear a band live. Musicians perform songs on a stage in front of an audience.” Bu tarif “concert” kelimesine uyar; concert = konser. Diğer şıklar: snack (atıştırmalık), promise (söz), best friend (en yakın arkadaş).

24

Tolga wants some gentle exercise and fresh air. He plans to move along the park paths on foot. He decides to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) go for a walk

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga wants some gentle exercise and fresh air. He plans to move along the park paths on foot.” Bu tarif “go for a walk” kelimesine uyar; go for a walk = yürüyüşe çıkmak. Diğer şıklar: share (paylaşmak), back up (arka çıkmak, desteklemek), break a promise (sözünü tutmamak).

25

Ozan organises a birthday celebration at home. His friends come for music, games and cake. They enjoy the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) party

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan organises a birthday celebration at home. His friends come for music, games and cake.” Bu tarif “party” kelimesine uyar; party = parti. Diğer şıklar: friendship (arkadaşlık, dostluk), treasure (hazine), loyalty (sadakat, vefa).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Mert has many friends, but he feels closest to Arda. He trusts Arda more than anyone else. Arda is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) best friend

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert has many friends, but he feels closest to Arda. He trusts Arda more than anyone else.” Bu tarif “best friend” kelimesine uyar; best friend = en yakın arkadaş. Diğer şıklar: treasure (hazine), guest (misafir, konuk), advice (tavsiye, öğüt).

2

Bora uses an informal word for a close companion. He calls Can his pal when they meet at the park. Can is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) buddy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora uses an informal word for a close companion. He calls Can his pal when they meet at the park.” Bu tarif “buddy” kelimesine uyar; buddy = kanka, yakın arkadaş. Diğer şıklar: secret (sır), snack (atıştırmalık), personality (kişilik).

3

Arda and Emir enjoy being friends. Their relationship includes trust, care and shared experiences. They value their ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) friendship

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda and Emir enjoy being friends. Their relationship includes trust, care and shared experiences.” Bu tarif “friendship” kelimesine uyar; friendship = arkadaşlık, dostluk. Diğer şıklar: concert (konser), loyalty (sadakat, vefa), party (parti).

4

Can learns another word for a friend. His teacher explains that this word can mean a companion or pal. The word is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) mate

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can learns another word for a friend. His teacher explains that this word can mean a companion or pal.” Bu tarif “mate” kelimesine uyar; mate = arkadaş, dost. Diğer şıklar: invitation (davet, davetiye), respect (saygı), bond (bağ).

5

Emir tells his friend that he definitely plans to help on Friday. He gives his word and intends to keep it. He makes a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) promise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir tells his friend that he definitely plans to help on Friday. He gives his word and intends to keep it.” Bu tarif “promise” kelimesine uyar; promise = söz. Diğer şıklar: friend for life (ömürlük arkadaş), excuse (mazeret, bahane), patience (sabır).

6

Baran tells İpek something private. He asks her not to tell anyone else. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) secret

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran tells İpek something private. He asks her not to tell anyone else.” Bu tarif “secret” kelimesine uyar; secret = sır. Diğer şıklar: bond (bağ), treasure (hazine), invitation (davet, davetiye).

7

Tolga describes his friend as honest and relaxed. He talks about character rather than hair or height. He describes his friend's ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) personality

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga describes his friend as honest and relaxed. He talks about character rather than hair or height.” Bu tarif “personality” kelimesine uyar; personality = kişilik. Diğer şıklar: buddy (kanka, yakın arkadaş), guest (misafir, konuk), friend for life (ömürlük arkadaş).

8

Ozan sits in the garden without anyone beside him. His friends are all inside the house. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) alone

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan sits in the garden without anyone beside him. His friends are all inside the house.” Bu tarif “alone” kelimesine uyar; alone = yalnız. Diğer şıklar: supportive (destekleyici), stuffed (tıka basa doymuş), reliable (güvenilir).

9

Yusuf finishes a large meal. He feels satisfied and does not need any more food. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) full

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf finishes a large meal. He feels satisfied and does not need any more food.” Bu tarif “full” kelimesine uyar; full = tok. Diğer şıklar: loyal (sadık, vefalı), serious (ciddi), busy (meşgul).

10

Aras stays relaxed when plans change. He does not worry about small problems or rush around. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) laid-back

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras stays relaxed when plans change. He does not worry about small problems or rush around.” Bu tarif “laid-back” kelimesine uyar; laid-back = sakin, rahat tavırlı. Diğer şıklar: honest (dürüst), outgoing (dışa dönük, girişken), unconditional (koşulsuz).

11

Gökçe respects Defne, and Defne respects Gökçe too. The same feeling exists on both sides. Their respect is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) mutual

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe respects Defne, and Defne respects Gökçe too. The same feeling exists on both sides.” Bu tarif “mutual” kelimesine uyar; mutual = karşılıklı. Diğer şıklar: thrilling (heyecan verici), full (tok), busy (meşgul).

12

Kerem values an old note from his closest friend. No amount of money can replace its meaning for him. To Kerem, the note is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) priceless

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem values an old note from his closest friend. No amount of money can replace its meaning for him.” Bu tarif “priceless” kelimesine uyar; priceless = paha biçilmez. Diğer şıklar: outgoing (dışa dönük, girişken), alone (yalnız), unconditional (koşulsuz).

13

Deniz discusses an important problem. He does not joke because he thinks it needs careful attention. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) serious

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz discusses an important problem. He does not joke because he thinks it needs careful attention.” Bu tarif “serious” kelimesine uyar; serious = ciddi. Diğer şıklar: laid-back (sakin, rahat tavırlı), mutual (karşılıklı), thrilling (heyecan verici).

14

Onur encourages his friend before an important performance. He offers help and gives her confidence. He is a ______ friend.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) supportive

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur encourages his friend before an important performance. He offers help and gives her confidence.” Bu tarif “supportive” kelimesine uyar; supportive = destekleyici. Diğer şıklar: stuffed (tıka basa doymuş), priceless (paha biçilmez), outgoing (dışa dönük, girişken).

15

Arda's family loves him without demanding anything in return. Their love does not depend on prizes or school marks. It is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) unconditional

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda's family loves him without demanding anything in return. Their love does not depend on prizes or school marks.” Bu tarif “unconditional” kelimesine uyar; unconditional = koşulsuz. Diğer şıklar: reliable (güvenilir), honest (dürüst), loyal (sadık, vefalı).

16

Ali's friend faces unfair criticism. Ali stands beside him and speaks in his defence. He wants to ______ his friend.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) back up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali's friend faces unfair criticism. Ali stands beside him and speaks in his defence.” Bu tarif “back up” kelimesine uyar; back up = arka çıkmak, desteklemek. Diğer şıklar: invite (davet etmek), get on well with (biriyle iyi geçinmek), go for a walk (yürüyüşe çıkmak).

17

Efe needs someone dependable for a difficult task. He knows Derya always helps when she agrees to do so. He can ______ her.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) count on

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe needs someone dependable for a difficult task. He knows Derya always helps when she agrees to do so.” Bu tarif “count on” kelimesine uyar; count on = güvenmek, bel bağlamak. Diğer şıklar: join (katılmak), text (mesaj atmak), share (paylaşmak).

18

Berk's friend wants to enter an art contest. Berk offers encouragement and helps her prepare her work. He wants to ______ her.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) support

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk's friend wants to enter an art contest. Berk offers encouragement and helps her prepare her work.” Bu tarif “support” kelimesine uyar; support = desteklemek. Diğer şıklar: trust (güvenmek), break a promise (sözünü tutmamak), apologise (özür dilemek).

19

Burak asks a friend to visit his house after school. They plan to play a board game in his living room. He asks his friend to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) come over

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak asks a friend to visit his house after school. They plan to play a board game in his living room.” Bu tarif “come over” kelimesine uyar; come over = birinin evine uğramak. Diğer şıklar: survive (ayakta kalmak, devam etmek), text (mesaj atmak), share (paylaşmak).

20

Tuna sees his friends playing a game. He wants to become part of their activity instead of watching. He asks if he can ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) join

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna sees his friends playing a game. He wants to become part of their activity instead of watching.” Bu tarif “join” kelimesine uyar; join = katılmak. Diğer şıklar: trust (güvenmek), go for a walk (yürüyüşe çıkmak), break a promise (sözünü tutmamak).

21

Aylin enjoys her grandmother's company. They talk and cook together for hours at the weekend. Aylin likes to ______ with her.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) spend time

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin enjoys her grandmother's company. They talk and cook together for hours at the weekend.” Bu tarif “spend time” kelimesine uyar; spend time = vakit geçirmek. Diğer şıklar: count on (güvenmek, bel bağlamak), support (desteklemek), invite (davet etmek).

22

Nehir needs to contact a friend without making a call. She types a short message on her phone. She decides to ______ her friend.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) text

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir needs to contact a friend without making a call. She types a short message on her phone.” Bu tarif “text” kelimesine uyar; text = mesaj atmak. Diğer şıklar: come over (birinin evine uğramak), get on well with (biriyle iyi geçinmek), apologise (özür dilemek).

23

İpek cannot attend a meeting because she has another appointment. She explains the reason for her absence. She gives an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) excuse

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek cannot attend a meeting because she has another appointment. She explains the reason for her absence.” Bu tarif “excuse” kelimesine uyar; excuse = mazeret, bahane. Diğer şıklar: party (parti), advice (tavsiye, öğüt), promise (söz).

24

Eylül welcomes a cousin into her home. The cousin comes for a visit and does not live there. The cousin is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) guest

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül welcomes a cousin into her home. The cousin comes for a visit and does not live there.” Bu tarif “guest” kelimesine uyar; guest = misafir, konuk. Diğer şıklar: respect (saygı), mate (arkadaş, dost), friendship (arkadaşlık, dostluk).

25

Cemre feels a little hungry between lunch and dinner. She eats a small amount of food instead of a full meal. She has a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) snack

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre feels a little hungry between lunch and dinner. She eats a small amount of food instead of a full meal.” Bu tarif “snack” kelimesine uyar; snack = atıştırmalık. Diğer şıklar: concert (konser), loyalty (sadakat, vefa), patience (sabır).

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

advice

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) tavsiye, öğüt

“advice” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “tavsiye, öğüt” olur. Bu ifade “Arkadaşlık kelimeleri” grubundandır. Örnek: My friend gave me good advice.

2

best friend

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) en yakın arkadaş

“best friend” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “en yakın arkadaş” olur. Bu ifade “Arkadaşlık kelimeleri” grubundandır. Örnek: Ece is my best friend.

3

bond

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) bağ

“bond” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “bağ” olur. Bu ifade “Arkadaşlık kelimeleri” grubundandır. Örnek: There is a strong bond between us.
